claims.summary: For binary Boolean matrices A of shape m by n and B of shape n by m, m>n>=1, the fixed residual P=product_(i,j)(1+delta_ij+(AB)_ij) has exact Boolean ideal order m-n+1: P belongs to I^(m-n+1) but not I^(m-n+2), I generated by entry Boolean axioms. An explicit rank-(n-1) Boolean point realizes the minimum order. Every fixed-point leading form is a product of degree-at-most-two forms with a small constant-depth circuit. Cheap Koszul perturbations prevent inferring that all residual-certificate coefficients have the corresponding deep ideal order. No IPS circuit lower bound follows.
